observations: body L1-L4: the end of the entry on p. 195, begun on p. XXIX. «دقيوس» stands between the guillemets of «« De-» «kious »», set right to left; «Vocabulaire destiné à fixer la transcription en français des noms» «des indigènes» is italic. A dot under the n of «in» (L2) is a speck.

body L5-L15: the entry on pp. 195-197, «195–197» bold, its long dash joined to the 5. «Heraclium imperatorem», «Hercule», «heraqlīs gabrā ḥkīmā», «Sibylla», «Les apocryphes éthiopiens», «Aethiopicam», «Hiraql al-ḥakīm», «Heraclitum» and «al-ǵawāb aṣ-ṣaḥīḥ li man» «baddal dīn al-Masīḥ» are italic; «Guidi», «Basset», «ash-Shah-» «rastānī» and «Ibn Taymiyyah» are letter-spaced. The o of «mythico» (L5) and the t of «transtulit» (L10) print broken. The dashes of L7 and L11 measure 10.6 and 9.7 pt; «27–40» (L10) has a long dash (5.8 pt).

body L10: the Ethiopic «ሰቤላ ፡ ወለተ ፡ ሕርቃል», Sabēllā walatta Ḥərqāl, with the word divider ፡ (two dots) between the words, renders «Sabēllā filia Ḥĕrqāl»; «Ḥĕrqāl» has the dot under the H and the breve over the e.
body L13: a paragraph begins inside the entry.
body L15: the year 1323 of the Hijra ran from 8 March 1905 to 24 February 1906; «1905» is the year of its beginning.

body L16-L19: the entry on pp. 201-202, «201–202» bold with a long dash (5.2 pt). «Ibn Ǵubayr» and «Muḥammad ibn aṭ-Ṭayyib al-‘Alamī» are letter-spaced; «shutan-» «bar» is italic. The dash of L18 measures 10.2 pt.
body L20-L21: the entry on p. 218, n. 2. «Marçais» is letter-spaced and «Revue de l'art musulman en Berbérie» italic.
body L22-L23: the entry on p. 234, «234» bold; «nomina intra minimum circulum omittens» is italic. «قاطاعرقا» is set right to left before the stop; the dash measures 9.8 pt.

body L24-L27: corrections to pp. 235, 291, 312 and 338, the page numbers bold. In «ζοδιακῷ» and «ζωδιακῷ» (L26) the κ is the open form of this type (ϰ) and the ω has the circumflex and the iota subscript.

body L28: the title of the Emendanda to the third volume, in large capitals; the face is not imitated and the line is scaled to the box of the printed line. The rule under it is 51.0 pt long and 0.84 pt thick; a speck stands to its left (0.8 pt). The running head of the page reads ADDENDA ET EMENDANDA AD TOMUM TERTIUM.

body L29-L31: the corrections to the Arabic text, the page numbers in Arabic-Indic numerals and the lines in European numerals; the Arabic is set right to left inside the Latin lines as printed. Each correction agrees with the Arabic text of the third volume as transcribed: p. ٢١, l. 22 has «السَّنْويّ»; p. ٢٦, l. 18 «الأَنْذَلُس», with a dhāl; p. ٢٨, l. 12 «ارقيانس», with a rā'; p. ٣٥, note 3 reads «Addidi, Platonem sequens.»; p. ٤٢, l. 15 «المُعوَّجة»; p. ٨٣, l. 7 «صار مركزه في فلك البروج», whose note 3 says that the codex has «مركز» before; p. ٩٥, l. 16 «يكون بقدر تعديله».

body L29: in the first word, «السَّٰنَوِيّ», a short upright stroke (a superscript alif, 1.2 by 1.7 pt) stands over the shadda of the sīn, where the second word, «السَّانَوِيّ», has the alif in the line and a fatḥa over the shadda. The two digits of «٢٦» touch at the top, as on p. XXIV. The sign = is printed long (11.0 pt).

body L30: on p. ٧٣, l. 12 the radius of the epicycle of Mars is printed «لط كه كب», 39;25,22. The correction reads «لط كز كب», 39;27,22, the value given in t. I, p. 48 (39p 27′ 22″); it is printed as the print sets it, «كب (cod. كه) كز لط» from left to right, so that in the right-to-left reading the codex's minutes, «كه», follow the corrected minutes, «كز».

body L31: «[مركزُه]» is the word added by the correction, with a ḍamma over the zāy, and «مركزَ» has a fatḥa; «[وتــر]», the chord, is the word added on p. ٩٥, as p. ٧٣, l. 14 calls the radius of the epicycle «وتر التعديل الاوسط». The elongated joins of «فلــك» and «وتــر» are transcribed with tatweels. No stop ends the line.
body: the dashes of L29-L31 measure 9.2-10.8 pt.

notes_left L1-L9, notes_right L1-L8: the end of note 3, begun on p. XXIX, in the left column and at the head of the right, and notes 1 and 2, with a thin rule between the columns. «Daqyūs», «Daqāsh», «Dgāsh», «Deguèche», «Kitāb as-siyar», «Taqyūs», «Analecta Syriaca», «Cureton» and «Haarbrücker» are italic; «ad-Dimashqī», «ash-Sham-» «mākhī» and «Lagarde» are letter-spaced. «Shaṭṭ» has the dot under both t's.
notes_left L5: a mark like a grave accent before «forma» is a speck.
notes_left L7-L8: «دقاس» is the reading of the edition of ad-Dimashqī, p. 238, set right to left; «Deqàs» has the grave accent.
notes_left L9: the year 928 of the Hijra ran from 1 December 1521 to 19 November 1522.

notes_right L1-L3: the dash measures 7.9 pt. A mark like a grave accent after «al-‘Ayyāshī» (L2) is a speck. The month Dhū 'l-qa‘dah of the year 1090 ran from 4 December 1679 to 2 January 1680, as printed («Decemb. 1679»).
